metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code with entry point (Node.js Fastify server), Dockerfile, ECS Fargate CloudFormation IaC, and PostgreSQL database connectivity. Single deployable microservice.
metadata.archetype_justification: PostgreSQL database with write operations (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE), CRUD endpoints (POST /orders, GET /orders/{id}, DELETE /orders/{id}), and customer-specific data (customer_id). Classified as stateful-crud.

top_gaps.title: CI/CD Automation
top_gaps.gap: No CI/CD pipeline exists — all deployments are manual
top_gaps.impact: Blocks safe, repeatable delivery; high risk of human error in production deployments

top_gaps.title: Integration Testing
top_gaps.gap: No test files exist in the repository despite vitest being configured
top_gaps.impact: Cannot validate service correctness before deployment; regressions reach production undetected

top_gaps.title: Workflow Orchestration
top_gaps.gap: Multi-step operations (refund, cancel) have no orchestration, retry logic, or compensation
top_gaps.impact: Failed partial operations leave data inconsistent; no recovery path for mid-workflow failures

top_gaps.title: Async Messaging and Streaming
top_gaps.gap: State changes cross service boundaries synchronously with no messaging
top_gaps.impact: Tight coupling to warehouse service; cascading failures on downstream outages

top_gaps.title: Distributed Tracing
top_gaps.gap: No tracing instrumentation — debugging cross-service failures is guesswork
top_gaps.impact: Cannot trace request flow through warehouse/payment calls; blind to latency sources

findings.title: Managed Databases — Multi-AZ failover unverifiable
findings.description: PostgreSQL database is on RDS (managed). The service connects via the pg driver with credentials from Secrets Manager. However, no RDS resource is defined in this repo's IaC — Multi-AZ failover configuration cannot be verified from in-repo evidence.
findings.gap: Cannot confirm automated failover (Multi-AZ) from in-repo evidence; RDS resource definition is absent from this repo's CloudFormation.
findings.recommendation: Include the RDS instance definition in this repo's IaC with Multi-AZ enabled, or document the reference to the infrastructure repo that owns it.

findings.title: Workflow Orchestration — no orchestration for multi-step operations
findings.description: Multi-step business operations (refund: DB update → payment processor; cancel: DB update → warehouse recall) are sequential synchronous calls with no orchestration, retry logic, or compensating actions. Archetype: stateful-crud — dedicated workflow orchestration is appropriate.
findings.gap: No workflow orchestration service for multi-step operations. Sequential synchronous calls with no retry, compensation, or error handling strategy.
findings.recommendation: Implement Step Functions to orchestrate the refund and cancel workflows with retry policies, error handling, and compensating actions.

findings.title: Async Messaging — no messaging for cross-service state changes
findings.description: No messaging or streaming infrastructure. State changes (refund, cancel) cross service boundaries via synchronous HTTP calls to the warehouse service. Archetype: stateful-crud — async messaging is appropriate for cross-service state changes.
findings.gap: No messaging where state changes cross service boundaries — tight synchronous coupling between the orders service and the warehouse/payment service.
findings.recommendation: Introduce SQS or EventBridge for cross-service state changes. Publish refund/cancel events asynchronously.

findings.title: Network Security — no explicit security groups
findings.description: ECS service deployed in private subnets (AssignPublicIp: DISABLED) but no explicit security groups defined. Default security group allows all inbound from same SG.
findings.gap: No explicit security groups with least-privilege rules. No VPC endpoints or PrivateLink.
findings.recommendation: Define explicit security groups allowing inbound only on port 3000 from ALB SG. Add VPC endpoints for Secrets Manager and CloudWatch Logs.

findings.title: API Entry Point — ALB not defined in IaC
findings.description: Template description states 'ECS Fargate behind an ALB' but no ALB resource is defined in this repo's IaC. No API Gateway, throttling, or request validation.
findings.gap: ALB referenced in architecture but not defined in IaC. No throttling or request validation at entry point.
findings.recommendation: Define ALB in CloudFormation with health checks. Consider API Gateway for throttling, request validation, and WAF integration.

findings.title: Auto-Scaling — no scaling configured
findings.description: No auto-scaling. ECS service has static DesiredCount: 2. No Application Auto Scaling policies.
findings.gap: All capacity is statically provisioned. No auto-scaling for ECS tasks.
findings.recommendation: Add Application Auto Scaling with target tracking on CPU utilization (70%) with min 2 / max 10 tasks.

findings.title: Backup and Recovery — no backup configuration
findings.description: No backup configuration in the repository. RDS instance not defined in IaC, so backup retention and PITR cannot be assessed.
findings.gap: No backup configuration found. Cannot verify backup retention, PITR, or restore procedures.
findings.recommendation: Define RDS in IaC with backup_retention_period >= 7 days and enable PITR. Add AWS Backup plan.

findings.title: High Availability — database Multi-AZ unconfirmed
findings.description: ECS service with DesiredCount: 2 across multiple subnets (likely multi-AZ). RDS database not defined in repo — Multi-AZ cannot be confirmed.
findings.gap: Cannot confirm database Multi-AZ from in-repo evidence. Compute likely spans AZs but data tier HA is unknown.
findings.recommendation: Define RDS with multi_az: true. Ensure SubnetIds span at least 2 AZs.

findings.title: IaC Coverage — significant gaps
findings.description: CloudFormation covers ECS cluster, task definition, service, IAM role, Secrets Manager secret. Missing: RDS, ALB, scaling, monitoring, backup. Estimated 40-50% coverage.
findings.gap: Significant infrastructure not in IaC — database, load balancer, scaling, monitoring, and backup are all missing.
findings.recommendation: Extend CloudFormation to cover all infrastructure surfaces the service depends on.

findings.title: CI/CD Automation — no pipeline exists
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline configuration exists. No GitHub Actions, Jenkinsfile, buildspec.yml, or any pipeline definition. All deployments are manual.
findings.gap: No CI/CD automation — all deployments are manual.
findings.recommendation: Create a CI/CD pipeline with lint, test, build, push to ECR, and deploy to ECS stages.

findings.title: Async vs Sync — all communication synchronous
findings.description: All inter-service communication is synchronous HTTP. WarehouseClient calls (issueRefund, recallDispatch) are synchronous. Archetype: stateful-crud — async for cross-service state propagation is the mature pattern.
findings.gap: All communication synchronous HTTP with no async patterns. Cross-service state changes are tightly coupled.
findings.recommendation: Introduce async for state-changing operations. Publish OrderRefunded/OrderCancelled events to EventBridge or SQS.

findings.title: Long-Running Process Handling — all operations synchronous
findings.description: Refund and cancel operations involve external service calls with variable latency, implemented as blocking synchronous operations with no timeout or async job processing. Archetype: stateful-crud — async handling for external dependencies is the mature pattern.
findings.gap: All operations synchronous regardless of duration. External service calls block the caller indefinitely.
findings.recommendation: Implement refund and cancel as async jobs: return 202 with job ID, process via SQS or Step Functions, provide status polling endpoint.

findings.title: API Versioning — no versioning strategy
findings.description: No API versioning strategy. Paths (/orders, /orders/{id}) have no version prefix. No Accept-Version headers.
findings.gap: No versioning — breaking changes deployed directly to all consumers.
findings.recommendation: Adopt URL-path versioning (e.g., /v2/orders). Maintain backward compatibility during deprecation periods.

findings.title: Service Discovery — environment variables only
findings.description: Service endpoints configured via environment variables (JWKS_URI, JWT_ISSUER). No dynamic discovery mechanism.
findings.gap: Environment variables for endpoints but no dynamic discovery. Relocating services requires redeployment.
findings.recommendation: Adopt AWS Cloud Map for dynamic service discovery of the warehouse service endpoint.

findings.title: Database Engine Version — not pinned in IaC
findings.description: README documents PostgreSQL 15 on RDS, but no RDS resource defined in repo's IaC. Engine version not controlled from this repository.
findings.gap: No engine version pinning in this repo's IaC. Version lifecycle management not visible.
findings.recommendation: Define RDS instance in CloudFormation with explicit engine version (EngineVersion: '15.4'). Document version update procedure.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest — database encryption unverifiable
findings.description: Secrets Manager secret encrypted by default (AWS-managed KMS). RDS not defined in repo — database encryption at rest cannot be verified. No customer-managed KMS keys.
findings.gap: Cannot confirm database encryption at rest. No customer-managed KMS keys.
findings.recommendation: Define RDS in IaC with StorageEncrypted: true and a customer-managed KMS key.

findings.title: API Authentication — no gateway-level auth
findings.description: All endpoints use JWT RS256 with remote JWKS and role-based access. Authentication is comprehensive at application level but no API Gateway authorization layer exists above.
findings.gap: No API Gateway or ALB-level auth. No request throttling at network entry point.
findings.recommendation: Add API Gateway with JWT authorizer as defense-in-depth layer for throttling and request validation.

findings.title: Secrets Management — no rotation configured
findings.description: AWS Secrets Manager used for DB password (GenerateSecretString). Secret injected via ECS task Secrets config. No plaintext credentials. Non-secret config appropriately in env vars.
findings.gap: No automated rotation configured on the database secret.
findings.recommendation: Add rotation Lambda and RotationSchedule to DbSecret for automatic credential rotation every 30 days.

findings.title: Compute Hardening — no vulnerability scanning
findings.description: Docker uses node:20-slim and runs as non-root (hardened). No vulnerability scanning, no Dependabot, no ECR image scanning.
findings.gap: No automated vulnerability scanning or patching. Base image updates are manual.
findings.recommendation: Add Dependabot for dependency updates. Enable ECR image scanning. Integrate container scanning in CI.

findings.title: Security Pipeline — no security scanning
findings.description: No security scanning tools. No CI/CD pipeline, no SAST, no dependency scanning, no container scanning, no Dependabot.
findings.gap: No security scanning tools configured. No pipeline security validation.
findings.recommendation: Add Dependabot, npm audit in CI, SAST tool (Semgrep), and container scanning with blocking gates.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing — no instrumentation
findings.description: No distributed tracing. No OpenTelemetry SDK, no X-Ray, no trace ID propagation on warehouse/payment calls.
findings.gap: No distributed tracing instrumented. Cross-service request flow cannot be traced.
findings.recommendation: Add OpenTelemetry SDK with X-Ray exporter. Propagate traceparent header on outbound calls.

findings.title: SLO Definitions — none defined
findings.description: No SLO definitions, no CloudWatch alarms, no monitoring artifacts. No formal definition of acceptable service levels.
findings.gap: No SLOs — no formal definition of acceptable service levels.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs: p99 latency < 500ms for GET, error rate < 0.1% for POST. Create CloudWatch alarms.

findings.title: Business Metrics — none published
findings.description: No custom metrics published. Only default CloudWatch Logs from awslogs driver. No business outcome tracking.
findings.gap: No custom metrics — only infrastructure logging.
findings.recommendation: Publish CloudWatch metrics: orders_created_total, refunds_processed_total, cancellation_rate. Use EMF structured logging.

findings.title: Anomaly Detection — no alerting
findings.description: No alerting configured. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection, no PagerDuty/OpsGenie integration.
findings.gap: No alerting — operational issues go undetected until user reports.
findings.recommendation: Create alarms: error rate > 1%, p99 latency > 2s, anomaly detection on volume. Integrate SNS + PagerDuty.

findings.title: Deployment Strategy — rolling only, no traffic shifting
findings.description: ECS rolling deployment with DeploymentCircuitBreaker (auto-rollback on failure). No blue/green, no canary, no weighted target groups.
findings.gap: Rolling deployment with health checks but no traffic shifting.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to CodeDeploy blue/green for ECS with canary traffic shifting and alarm-based rollback.

findings.title: Integration Testing — no tests exist
findings.description: vitest configured as devDependency with test script, but no test files exist. No unit, integration, contract, or e2e tests.
findings.gap: No automated tests. Cannot validate service correctness before deployment.
findings.recommendation: Write integration tests covering all 5 endpoints using vitest + testcontainers. Add to CI as blocking gate.

findings.title: Incident Response — no runbooks
findings.description: No runbooks, no SSM Automation, no incident response automation. Entirely ad hoc.
findings.gap: No runbooks — incident response is ad hoc.
findings.recommendation: Create runbooks for common incidents: DB connection exhaustion, warehouse timeout, elevated 5xx. Migrate to SSM Automation.

findings.title: Observability Ownership — none defined
findings.description: No dashboards, no named alarm owners, no CODEOWNERS for observability. Only CloudWatch Logs config exists.
findings.gap: No observability ownership — monitoring is reactive and fragmented.
findings.recommendation: Create CloudWatch dashboard for orders service. Add CODEOWNERS for observability configs. Define alarm owners.

findings.title: Resource Tagging — no tags on resources
findings.description: No tags on any CloudFormation resources. No cost allocation, ownership, or environment identification.
findings.gap: No tags found on resources.
findings.recommendation: Add consistent tags (Environment, Service, Team, CostCenter) to all CloudFormation resources.

evaluations.title: Managed Compute
evaluations.reason: All compute on ECS Fargate — fully managed serverless containers, no EC2.

evaluations.title: Programming Languages
evaluations.reason: Node.js 20 + TypeScript 5.4 + Fastify 4 — modern cloud-native language/framework at current versions.

evaluations.title: Monolith vs Microservices
evaluations.reason: Single independently deployable microservice with well-defined boundaries, typed interfaces, and OpenAPI spec.

evaluations.title: Unstructured Data Storage
evaluations.reason: Service handles exclusively structured data. No unstructured data in domain — no gap.

evaluations.title: Unified Data Access Layer
evaluations.reason: All DB access centralized in OrderService class. No SQL leaks into other modules.

evaluations.title: Stored Procedures and Schema Complexity
evaluations.reason: No stored procedures, triggers, or proprietary SQL. All business logic in application layer.

evaluations.title: Audit Logging
evaluations.reason: Application-level IaC only (ECS, IAM, Secrets Manager). CloudTrail is account-level — evaluation belongs in foundation infrastructure repo.

evaluations.title: Centralized Identity Integration
evaluations.reason: Remote JWKS integration with centralized IdP. JWT validation with issuer/audience claims and role-based access.
